summary: Validate stored Booksy playbooks against read-only command schemas, return argument arrays, and omit unsafe legacy records before recall.
reason: Locally stored playbooks and notes are untrusted. Command strings and control-plane flags must not become executable instructions.
validated_outcome: Offline tests reject shell syntax in legacy command text, unknown commands and flags, bad typed arguments, missing service variants, and unsafe legacy recall while preserving separate multiword arguments and synthesized value slots without changing output color.
